description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for connectivity-related events within the Eclipse Ditto framework, including JSON serialization and common properties.

classes.name: AbstractConnectivityEvent
classes.description: An abstract class representing a connectivity-related event with properties like type, connection ID, timestamp, and headers, including JSON serialization.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the connection associated with the event.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the timestamp of the event, if available.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional as default; subclasses may override.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with the event.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the event type as its manifest string.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the event to a JSON object, including common and event-specific payload.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to add custom payload to JSON serialization.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on type, connection ID, timestamp, and headers.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper for equality check, confirms class type.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on core properties.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the event.
